steps.title: Questions: What Made Them Reach Out
steps.content:
(Write down every concern they name.)

{{contact_first_name}}, I'm going to run through a few things people often notice. Just say yes if you get them at all, even if they're mild or come and go.

You submitted a form about the program. About how much weight would you like to lose?

Have your eating habits slipped lately, more than you'd like?

How's your energy through the day, any afternoon crashes?

How have you been sleeping?

Do you feel irritable or under a lot of stress?

Any allergy or sinus problems, even ones you think are normal?

Any pain, stiffness, or soreness in your neck or back?

What about your knees, hips, or feet?

Any headaches, even mild ones?

And are you taking any medications, prescribed or over the counter?

Of those, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below. If weight is their only concern, use the weight-focus button.)

steps.title: Making It Real
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'd like to ask three quick questions about {{main_concern}}. This helps us get ready for your visit.

How long has it been bothering you, like a month or two, or longer than that?

(Let them answer. If it fits, you can say "Got it.")

Is it something you notice like a few days a month, or is it most days?

(Let them answer. If it fits, you can say "I see." or "I understand.")

When it's at its worst, does it ever interfere with work, at home, or relaxing and doing your own thing?

(Let them answer. If they name an impact, reflect only what they said about work, home, or their own time. If not, you can say "Got it, thank you.")

steps.title: The Recommendation
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, that's exactly what the {{offer_name}} is for. Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you in for the {{offer_name}}. Here's what it includes:

{{offer_items}}

{{price_line}}

{{provider_name}} takes a look at {{main_concern}} and where things are. If the program can help, we'll walk you through what it would look like for you. If it's not the right fit, we'll say so. Either way you'll know where you stand. Does that sound reasonable?

(Tap what you hear.)

steps.title: The Recommendation: Weight Focus
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, can I say something? You already did the hardest part by reaching out. Most people carry this around for years before they do that. Does that make sense?

(Wait for the yes.)

{{contact_first_name}}, can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

{{provider_name}} sees where things are and what the program would look like for you. If we can help, we'll tell you. If it's not the right fit, we'll tell you that too. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: Objection: “I should be able to do it on my own”
steps.content:
I understand, {{contact_first_name}}, and that's a good instinct.

What's happened the times you've tried on your own?

(Let them answer. Give them credit for trying.)

Most people know what to do. What's missing isn't the knowledge, it's the structure and someone checking in. On your own, the first busy week undoes a month of effort. That's not a willpower problem. It's a support problem.

The {{offer_name}} isn't a whole program. It's a look at {{main_concern}} and what the smallest version of that support would be.

Would it help to have that structure, even for a few weeks?

steps.title: Objection: Cost (weight is the focus)
steps.content:
I understand, {{contact_first_name}}. Is it the cost of the first visit, or the thought of paying for a whole program?

(Let them answer.)

{{price_line}}

That covers the first visit, and you're not signing up for the program on the phone. The visit is where you find out what it would take for you. You hear the numbers before you decide anything.

Think about how you'd feel in your clothes, the energy, all of it. How much does getting there matter to you?

(Let them answer. This is the question that does the work.)

Can we at least get you in so we can see where you're at?

steps.title: Objection: “I’ve seen a chiropractor. It didn’t help”
steps.content:
That's fair, {{contact_first_name}}, and I'm glad you told me.

What were they treating, and how long did you give it?

(Let them answer. Do not knock the other office.)

No two offices approach this the same way, and a lot comes down to finding what's driving the problem. If the cause of {{main_concern}} was never found, adjustments alone wouldn't have held. That's not a reason to give up on it. It's a reason to get a proper look.

{{provider_name}} will tell you straight whether this is something we can help with. If it isn't, we'll say so and point you in a better direction.

Is that worth one visit to find out?
